question: What is the Resulticks acquisition supposed to unlock — revenue synergies or cost savings?

beats.line: Resulticks is a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.
beats.headline: REVENUE SYNERGY
beats.action: A halftone paper platform slab lowers onto a cream chip and settles flat.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Resulticks is a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.

beats.line: The one point five billion deal adds AI customer data capabilities.
beats.headline: $1.5B
subjects: a stacked sheet of data cards
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left edge as the platform slab widens; a stacked sheet of data cards drops on top and locks in.
beats.delivery: [excited] The one point five billion deal adds AI customer data capabilities.

beats.line: That turns a point solution into an integrated end-to-end platform.
beats.headline: END-TO-END
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the platform slab's loose panels are taped edge to edge into one continuous sheet.
beats.delivery: That turns a point solution into an integrated end-to-end platform.

beats.line: Diginex can now serve two distinct enterprise workflows.
beats.headline: 2 WORKFLOWS
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the platform slab splits into two paper workflow cards; a stencilled arrow enters and runs between them.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] Diginex can now serve two distinct enterprise workflows.

beats.line: Same customer base, broader product suite, higher wallet share.
beats.headline: CROSS-SELL
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top as a paper hand enters and pushes the two workflow cards together until they overlap and hold.
beats.delivery: Same customer base, broader product suite, higher wallet share.

beats.line: The risk is integration complexity across four absorbed acquisitions.
beats.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the overlapped cards fan out into four paper folders; string and pins stretch between them and pull tight.
beats.delivery: The risk is integration complexity across four absorbed acquisitions.

beats.line: G and A costs rose to eight point one million.
beats.headline: $8.1M G&A
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the right edge as the four folders stack and rise into a single paper bar that climbs and stops.
beats.delivery: G and A costs rose to eight point one million.

beats.line: Two point two million came from merger and acquisition legal work.
beats.headline: $2.2M LEGAL
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as a torn strip peels off the paper bar; a rubber stamp presses down on the strip and lifts away.
beats.delivery: Two point two million came from merger and acquisition legal work.

beats.line: Watch for cross-sell traction and accelerating combined revenue growth.
beats.headline: WHAT MATTERS NEXT
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the stamped strip flattens into a paper calendar page; a torn-paper arrow rises across it and holds.
beats.delivery: Watch for cross-sell traction and accelerating combined revenue growth.

beats.line: Without that, it's financial engineering, not a strategic unlock.
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the bottom as the arrow folds back into the platform slab; a paper hand rests one corner down and holds it steady.
beats.delivery: Without that, it's financial engineering, not a strategic unlock.
